Follow the [local contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and shared policy linked there.
Keep this PR focused on one problem or coherent change.

## Owning issue

Closes #

Automated dependency updates and administrative metadata changes do not require a separate issue.

## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or standards outcome.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No public compatibility impact
- [ ] Compatibility impact is documented in the owning issue and migration guidance

## Verification

- [ ] For a defect, the same public-workflow regression fails on the relevant base and passes on the fix
- [ ] Exact base/fix revisions, commands, and results are included; documentation uses relevant checks
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass
- [ ] `ty` passes
- [ ] Test suite passes
- [ ] Package build passes when applicable
- [ ] Strict MkDocs build passes when documentation is affected
- [ ] Ecosystem qualification passes

## Documentation and release

State the documentation, release notes, and patch-release work required after merge.

## AI assistance and accountability

State whether AI assisted with code or prose and identify its contribution.

- [ ] I reviewed and tested this submission and can explain its implementation and evidence
